clue.text: Sauce demonstrated by a youth during riot

indicators.note: during places the youth phrase inside the riot word, as if happening in the middle of it

parts.note: something hilarious is a riot or a scream
a lad is a youth

explanation.surface: A young lad shows off a condiment in the middle of a street disturbance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'demonstrated by' is link material: the sauce is shown by the wordplay. SALAD CREAM is a bottled British dressing, a tangy mayonnaise-like sauce.
explanation.definitionFit: This British bottled condiment is a kind of sauce, used on salads.

clue.text: Plant border suffering?

annotationWithheld.why: Plant border suffering? (8): RIM (border) inside AGONY (suffering) gives AGRIMONY, but the only insertion signal is 'Plant', which is also the definition, so one word does two jobs

clue.text: Topping worker, joiner

indicators.note: topping a word means cutting off its first letter, its head

parts.note: a hand is a manual worker

explanation.surface: A top-class worker who makes joints in wood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Topping' looks like praise for the worker but means remove the top letter. A conjunction is a joiner because it joins clauses.
explanation.definitionFit: A conjunction links words or clauses, so crosswords call it a joiner.

clue.text: One inside cut shell, solid, curved

indicators.note: inside places the numeral within the shortened shell word
cut means the shell word loses its last letter

parts.note: a conch is a large spiral seashell
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Description of a curved solid object with something placed inside a broken shell.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut' docks CONCH to CONC, and 'inside' puts I in it: CON-I-C.
explanation.definitionFit: Something cone-shaped is a curved solid, tapering to a point from a round base.

clue.text: Record arrangement of green centrepiece

parts.note: EP stands for extended-play record

indicators.note: an arrangement of the letters of green rearranges them

explanation.surface: A record of how green things are arranged in a table display.
explanation.walkthrough: 'arrangement of' rearranges GREEN to RGNE. An EPERGNE is an ornamental table centrepiece holding fruit or flowers.
explanation.definitionFit: This ornate dish stand is designed to sit in the middle of a dining table as decoration.

clue.text: June 2st 2000?

annotationWithheld.why: June 2st 2000? (9): the clue as held is garbled ('2st'), the scan does not show it and a search did not find the printed text, so its wordplay for MIDSUMMER cannot be checked

clue.text: Face showing pretentious attitude

definitions.meaning: a face of a solid or surface
putting on ... means acting superior or showing airs

explanation.surface: A face that reveals a snooty manner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Side' as airs and graces is a chiefly British usage: someone with no side is unpretentious.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are standard: a facet of a cube, and haughty affectation.

clue.text: Identified person investigating pudding

parts.note: to spot something is to identify it
dick is slang for a detective

explanation.surface: A detective has been recognised by someone else.
explanation.walkthrough: SPOTTED DICK is a British steamed suet pudding with currants.
explanation.definitionFit: This traditional British dessert is a suet sponge dotted with dried fruit.

clue.text: Award given for small part

definitions.meaning: a university awards a qualification such as a BA
a ... is a small step or amount, as in to a ...

explanation.surface: A prize handed out for playing a minor role.
explanation.definitionFit: A degree is both an academic award and a small unit or stage of something.

clue.text: Former amateur sport died accessing money in economy

indicators.note: accessing means getting into, so the sport and died go inside the money word

parts.note: pence are coins, money
RU is rugby union, which was strictly amateur until 1995

explanation.surface: An old amateur sportsman died after breaking into funds meant to be saved.
explanation.walkthrough: PENCE holds RU and D: PE-RUD-NCE. Rugby union only allowed professionals from 1995.
explanation.definitionFit: Economy in the sense of thrift or careful management of money is prudence.

clue.text: Doctor on journey to see idiot in Australia

parts.note: a go is a turn or trip, as in go somewhere

explanation.surface: A doctor travels to visit a fool down under.
explanation.walkthrough: A DRONGO is an Australian slang word for a fool, also the name of a bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Australian slang uses this bird name as a mild insult for a stupid person.

clue.text: Mention me spinning, inducing sickness

indicators.note: spinning turns the pieces right round so they are read backwards

parts.note: to cite something is to mention it
taken as written

explanation.surface: Talking about me while I spin round makes me feel ill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spinning' turns CITE + ME into EMETIC.
explanation.definitionFit: An emetic is a substance that causes vomiting, so it is used adjectivally for producing nausea.

clue.text: Climbing aid lifting worker into vehicle

indicators.note: into places the turned worker inside the vehicle

parts.note: a tricycle is a three-wheeled vehicle

indicators.note: lifting in a down clue means the word is read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: a bee, especially a worker bee, is the crossword worker

explanation.surface: A climbing aid hoisting a labourer into a car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lifting' turns BEE to EEB, which goes into TRICYCLE: TR-EEB-ICYCLE. A tree bicycle is a device for climbing tree trunks.
explanation.definitionFit: A tree bicycle is a pedal-driven contraption that grips a trunk to help a climber ascend.

clue.text: Happy sound of porker went first

parts.note: a pig, a porker, grunts
led means went in front

explanation.surface: A contented pig's noise came out before anything else.
explanation.walkthrough: GRUNTLED is a jocular back-formation from disgruntled, meaning pleased.
explanation.definitionFit: Being gruntled, the humorous opposite of disgruntled, is being satisfied or happy.

clue.text: Queen in muddle when messed about, less than impressed

indicators.note: in places the queen inside the jumbled letters
messed about means the letters are jumbled into a new order

parts.note: ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: The Queen in a muddle when things are messed up is not impressed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'messed about' signals the anagram and 'in' the insertion; 'less than impressed' is the playful opposite of overwhelmed.
explanation.definitionFit: To be underwhelmed is to find something disappointing, a humorous counterpart of overwhelmed.

clue.text: Tiny creature felt aware in metamorphosis

indicators.note: a metamorphosis is a change of form, so the letters change their order

explanation.surface: A small animal sensed it was turning into something else.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in metamorphosis' rearranges FELT AWARE. A water flea, or daphnia, is a tiny crustacean.
explanation.definitionFit: Water fleas are minute freshwater crustaceans, so tiny creature describes them.

clue.text: Spent 100%, in summary

parts.note: all in means exhausted, spent
a hundred per cent is all of something

explanation.surface: Completely exhausted, to sum things up.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means taking everything into account, a way of summing up.

clue.text: Live bug thing, subatomic fast-mover

parts.note: to be is to live or exist
to tap a phone is to bug it
an article is an object or thing

explanation.surface: Something electronic and alive, a speedy tiny object.
explanation.walkthrough: A beta particle is a high-speed electron emitted in radioactive decay.
explanation.definitionFit: These emitted electrons travel very fast and are smaller than an atom.

clue.text: Old rug with which beast wraps cable up

indicators.note: wraps means the beast goes round the other piece

parts.note: a pig is a beast

indicators.note: up in a down clue means read from the bottom, so backwards

parts.note: a wire is a cable

explanation.surface: An ancient carpet that an animal rolls a cable inside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' signals the reversal and 'wraps' the container. 'Rug' is slang for a wig, and a periwig is the long wig of the 17th and 18th centuries.
explanation.definitionFit: A periwig is a historic wig, and rug is humorous slang for a hairpiece.

clue.text: Bring up black fish

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
the roach is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: Vomiting a dark fish.
explanation.definitionFit: To broach a topic is to raise it, to bring it up in conversation.

clue.text: One securing for one preserving

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of
a curer preserves meat or fish by salting or smoking

explanation.surface: Someone getting hold of something for someone who keeps food from spoiling.
explanation.definitionFit: A procurer obtains or secures things, often for someone else.

clue.text: Tiny antelope knocks twin children over

indicators.note: knocks and over together say knock over, topple each piece backwards
over completes knocks over, telling the solver to turn each word round

parts.note: two children: a kid is a child, and twins mean two of them
the second of the pair of children

explanation.surface: A small antelope bowls over a pair of youngsters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'knocks ... over' signals one reversal applied to each child in place. A dik-dik is a small African antelope.
explanation.definitionFit: The dik-dik is one of the smallest antelopes, found in eastern Africa.

clue.text: Dry bread inferior to delicious starter

indicators.note: inferior means lower, so in a down clue the bread sits under the starter
a starter is what begins, so the first letter of delicious

parts.note: a roll is a small loaf of bread

explanation.surface: Stale bread served beneath a tasty first course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dry' as in dry humour: droll means wryly amusing.
explanation.definitionFit: Dry wit is understated humour, and droll describes that quietly funny manner.

clue.text: Scrub part of church, abandoning hospital

indicators.note: abandoning means the hospital letter is left out

parts.note: the chancel is the part of a church around the altar
H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs

explanation.surface: Clean part of a church after leaving hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: To scrub a plan is to call it off, which is to cancel it.

clue.text: Court award given to an elder worker, perhaps?

parts.note: to court someone is to woo them
the DSM is the Distinguished Service Medal
taken as written

explanation.surface: Wooing a senior employee with a medal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'elder' is not an older person but the elder tree, which a forester works among.
explanation.definitionFit: A woodsman works with trees, and the elder is one, so he is an elder worker by example.

clue.text: Water source knocks out base of bridge

indicators.note: knocks out base means the bottom letter of the word, in a down clue, is removed

parts.note: a span is a bridge or the stretch of one

explanation.surface: A spring of water demolishes the foundation of a bridge.
explanation.definitionFit: A spa is a mineral spring, a source of water.

clue.text: Butter pudding he eagerly gulps

indicators.note: gulps means the words swallow the answer, holding it inside

explanation.surface: A man greedily wolfing down butter pudding.
explanation.walkthrough: puddinG HE Eagerly. Ghee is clarified butter used in South Asian cooking.
explanation.definitionFit: Ghee is clarified butter, a staple cooking fat in Indian cuisine.

clue.text: Drop of water in South America, so one fewer in heaven?

definitions.text: Drop of water in South America
definitions.meaning: the Venezuelan waterfall with the world's highest single drop
if a heavenly being tumbles out, heaven has one fewer

explanation.surface: A big waterfall abroad, and the loss of a celestial being.
explanation.walkthrough: The second half reads the name as a sentence: a heavenly being drops out of heaven.
explanation.definitionFit: This Venezuelan cascade is the tallest uninterrupted waterfall in the world.
